presets.note: 1-Step evaluation, Silver $5,000. Profit target is 10% or 20% of capital, chosen at purchase, and is not a loss rule. Daily loss limit is 3%, 4%, or none, chosen at purchase. Max drawdown $300 is the docs floor table for Silver (6% of $5,000). Static floor: it does not trail and it does not lock. Drawdown touch is not preset. Loss Limits (https://docs.vestmarkets.com/vest-capital/loss-limits) says equality alone does not breach. The Vest Markets in-app FAQ says touching the max-drawdown floor closes the account. Confirm the checkbox. DLL basis text is the Loss Limits page (reset balance excludes unrealized PnL and includes reserved collateral; transfers move the floor). The in-app FAQ example uses equity at 20:00 ET, which that FAQ says includes unrealized PnL. Enter the reset balance from the dashboard. No mini or micro contract count is published. The in-app FAQ says there is no per-trade position-size limit beyond the loss rules. Leverage figures conflict (purchase-catalog maxLeverage 5.0000, in-app FAQ up to 50x, docs overview up to 75x) and are not filled in. Type NONE or your own cap.
